note: The cell from Happy Mouse Labs' game bundles (Sky, 2026-11-12: "replace our main cell with these characters and animations"). Each figure keeps its own mesh, textures, skeleton and clips; nothing is decimated or resized. `states` maps a state of the shared controller (People/Generated/Figures.controller) to one of the bundle's game actions (manifest.json gamePrep.actions[].name); `byFigure` overrides it for one figure. `extras` are states only the cell has. A state with no action for a figure is left out (it keeps the shared clip, which cannot move this rig, so the host never picks it for the cell).

scout.label: Scout (HML game bundle 2026-11-12: white hooded top, black shorts, sneakers)

fixer.label: Fixer (HML game bundle 2026-11-12: black and white halter jumpsuit, long gloves, white boots)

tech.label: Tech (HML game bundle 2026-11-12: black wrap vest, wide trousers, visor)

enforcer.label: Enforcer (HML game bundle 2026-11-12: white and black long coat, white boots, carbine)

seconds_note: The host fits `draw` to the rulebook's draw time from a 2.0 s clip (HostViews.Figures DrawClipS), so every figure's draw is re-timed to 2.0 s (the Enforcer's is 2.9 s in the bundle).

carry_shoulder.note: the figure's own walk with the right arm clamping the legs of the person over the right shoulder (the recipe of author_clips.make_carry)

carry_shoulder_idle.note: the figure's own idle with the same right arm

seat.note: tools/figures/seat.json: the root stands on the chair's point and the pelvis rests on the cushion (0.474 m up). The bundle's sit clips have no seat, so each is slid until its seated pose (stand_to_sit: its last frame; sit_to_stand: its first; the loops: their mean) has the hip joints 0.095 m above the cushion (scaled by the figure's height) and 0.05 m behind the chair's point; if that puts the soles under the floor the clip is lifted until they stand on it.

byFigure_note: A value may be {"clip": name, "loop": bool}: a clip the bundle holds that is not one of its game actions. The Scout's walk: the cell walks at 1.8 m/s (rulebook op-speed-cm-s) and her Walk action (Walking (2)) is a 0.92 m/s stroll, which would play at 1.96 times its speed; the bundle's other walk (Walking, 1.44 m/s) plays at 1.25. Her Walk action stays as walk_stroll.
groundSkip_note: Every other take is put on the floor (cell_hml_clips.ground): dropped if it floats, and each frame whose sole is under y = 0 lifted by that much; these keep the bundle's height (lying down, seated, in a car).
